findings.summary: Extension-based matcher exclusion lets any future dotted page/API path (/users/a.b, /api/x.csv) bypass the prelaunch gate; restrict to explicit asset folders/extensions

redirected ref survives a proxy bounce (same component reconciled with new serverNow), so after one premature redirect the timer never redirects at real launch; reset ref per effect or key by serverNow
Invalid EVENT_START_AT logs console.error on every proxied request (no value leaked); memoise per isolate
test-1 claims 307 but asserts only final URL; test-6 (:119) never asserts no-early/single /login request; no hydration-error guard
Suspense fallback height omits scaled gap/label (122.88s+48px vs 122.88s+21s+48s), causing ~10-20px CLS
next/image priority is deprecated in Next 16 (use preload); 3.1MB background PNG needs Workers image optimisation or pre-compression
Group aria-label plus readable digit spans and visible label double-announce; aria-hide inner spans; English labels lack lang=en
Offset sampled after hydration makes the client trail the server by time-to-hydrate; redirect slightly late (safe direction)
redirect() inside streamed Suspense slot yields a client meta redirect, not a 307; unreachable while proxy fails open
Gate covers /api/* and POSTs (307 to an HTML page); decide on an api exclusion when the first route handler lands
